title: Texas's 21st Congressional District Election, 2026
description: An open-seat race for Texas's 21st Congressional District sparked by incumbent Republican Rep. Chip Roy's decision to run for Texas Attorney General instead of seeking re-election. The district spans from northern San Antonio through the Texas Hill Country to the southern suburbs of Austin and has reliably favored Republicans, with Donald Trump carrying it by 23 percentage points in 2024. Republican nominee Mark Teixeira, a former Major League Baseball star, will face Democratic nominee Kristin Hook, a biological scientist and former federal employee, along with independent candidate Eldon 'Dan' McQueen, a former Corpus Christi mayor and Navy veteran. The general election will determine who represents the district in the U.S. House for the 119th Congress.
polling_note: No public opinion polls were found specifically for the 2026 TX-21 general election as of mid-2026.

candidates.name: Mark Teixeira
candidates.summary: Mark 'Tex' Teixeira is a former Major League Baseball first baseman who played 14 seasons for the Texas Rangers and New York Yankees, earning three All-Star selections and a World Series championship in 2009. He won the Republican primary for Texas's 21st Congressional District on March 3, 2026, with approximately 61% of the vote, receiving endorsements from President Donald Trump and Governor Greg Abbott. Teixeira campaigns on a conservative platform emphasizing border security, gun rights, education freedom, and support for the Trump agenda.

candidates.name: Kristin Hook
candidates.summary: Dr. Kristin Hook is a biological scientist and former federal employee who won the Democratic primary for Texas's 21st Congressional District on March 3, 2026, with approximately 60% of the vote, after previously serving as the Democratic nominee in the district in 2024. She holds a PhD in behavioral biology from Cornell University and has worked at the National Institutes of Health, the U.S. Government Accountability Office, and as an oversight investigator for U.S. Senator Elizabeth Warren. Hook campaigns on a platform focused on affordability, economic opportunity for working families, healthcare access, protecting democracy, and holding corporations and special interests accountable.

candidates.name: Eldon Dan McQueen
candidates.summary: Eldon 'Dan' McQueen is an independent candidate for Texas's 21st Congressional District who previously served as mayor of Corpus Christi for 37 days in 2017 before resigning. He is a U.S. Navy combat search-and-rescue veteran and an engineer who worked on the Air Force One VC25B presidential aircraft program. McQueen campaigns on a platform focused on infrastructure, water security, border security, veterans' issues, and a 'Texas Sky Corridor' plan integrating roads, smart traffic, and advanced air mobility.

forecast.rationale: Texas's 21st Congressional District is a heavily Republican district where Donald Trump won by 23 points in 2024. Although incumbent Chip Roy vacated the seat to run for Attorney General, Republican nominee Mark Teixeira — a former MLB All-Star with endorsements from President Trump and Governor Abbott — offers strong name recognition and crossover appeal. Democratic nominee Kristin Hook is a credible candidate with a PhD and prior experience as the 2024 nominee, but faces a severe structural disadvantage in this district. Independent Dan McQueen's brief 37-day mayoral tenure and lack of organized campaign infrastructure make a third-party breakthrough unlikely. No public opinion polls exist for this race as of mid-2026, which tempers confidence, but the district's strong Republican baseline and candidate environment support a safe Republican rating.
